from controller import Controller


def test_start_increases_generation():
    c = Controller()
    assert c.generation == 0
    g1 = c.start()
    assert g1 == 1
    g2 = c.start()
    assert g2 == 2
    g3 = c.start()
    assert g3 == 3


def test_start_sets_busy_true():
    c = Controller()
    assert c.busy == False
    c.start()
    assert c.busy == True


def test_start_preserves_rows():
    c = Controller()
    c.rows = [1, 2, 3]
    c.start()
    assert c.rows == [1, 2, 3]


def test_start_preserves_decisions():
    c = Controller()
    c.decisions = {"a": 1}
    c.start()
    assert c.decisions == {"a": 1}


def test_poll_status_queued_returns_false():
    c = Controller()
    c.start()
    result = c.poll_status(1, 'queued')
    assert result == False
    assert c.busy == True


def test_poll_status_running_returns_false():
    c = Controller()
    c.start()
    result = c.poll_status(1, 'running')
    assert result == False
    assert c.busy == True


def test_poll_status_completed_returns_true_once():
    c = Controller()
    c.start()
    r1 = c.poll_status(1, 'completed')
    assert r1 == True
    # Second call with same generation should return False (once only)
    r2 = c.poll_status(1, 'completed')
    assert r2 == False


def test_poll_status_failed_ends_busy():
    c = Controller()
    c.start()
    result = c.poll_status(1, 'failed')
    assert result == False
    assert c.busy == False


def test_poll_status_stale_generation_returns_false():
    c = Controller()
    g1 = c.start()  # generation 1
    r1 = c.poll_status(g1, 'completed')
    assert r1 == True
    g2 = c.start()  # generation 2
    # Old generation should be stale
    r2 = c.poll_status(g1, 'completed')
    assert r2 == False


def test_finish_accepts_latest_completed():
    c = Controller()
    g = c.start()
    c.poll_status(g, 'completed')  # Mark as completed
    rows = [4, 5, 6]
    result = c.finish(g, rows)
    assert result == True
    assert c.rows == [4, 5, 6]
    assert c.busy == False


def test_finish_copies_rows():
    c = Controller()
    g = c.start()
    c.poll_status(g, 'completed')
    original = [1, 2, 3]
    c.finish(g, original)
    # Modifying original should not affect c.rows
    original.append(4)
    assert c.rows == [1, 2, 3]


def test_finish_stale_generation_returns_false():
    c = Controller()
    g1 = c.start()
    c.poll_status(g1, 'completed')
    g2 = c.start()  # New generation
    result = c.finish(g1, [1])
    assert result == False


def test_finish_unrequested_returns_false():
    c = Controller()
    g = c.start()
    # Never called poll_status for completed, so unrequested
    result = c.finish(g, [1])
    assert result == False


def test_finish_only_once():
    c = Controller()
    g = c.start()
    c.poll_status(g, 'completed')
    rows1 = [1, 2, 3]
    r1 = c.finish(g, rows1)
    assert r1 == True
    # Second finish should fail (already consumed)
    rows2 = [4, 5, 6]
    r2 = c.finish(g, rows2)
    assert r2 == False


def test_set_decision_persists():
    c = Controller()
    c.set_decision("job1", "value1")
    assert c.decisions["job1"] == "value1"


def test_set_decision_independent_of_refreshes():
    c = Controller()
    c.set_decision("job1", "value1")
    c.start()  # Refresh
    assert c.decisions["job1"] == "value1"
    c.start()  # Another refresh
    assert c.decisions["job1"] == "value1"


def test_no_network_calls():
    """Verify no network-related imports or calls are used."""
    import inspect
    source = inspect.getsource(Controller)
    assert 'http' not in source.lower()
    assert 'socket' not in source.lower()
    assert 'urllib' not in source.lower()


def test_workflow():
    """Test a complete workflow."""
    c = Controller()
    
    # Start first job
    g1 = c.start()
    assert c.busy == True
    
    # Poll - queued
    assert c.poll_status(g1, 'queued') == False
    assert c.busy == True
    
    # Poll - running
    assert c.poll_status(g1, 'running') == False
    assert c.busy == True
    
    # Poll - completed (should return True once)
    assert c.poll_status(g1, 'completed') == True
    
    # Duplicate poll
    assert c.poll_status(g1, 'completed') == False
    
    # Finish with results
    rows = [10, 20, 30]
    assert c.finish(g1, rows) == True
    assert c.rows == [10, 20, 30]
    assert c.busy == False


def test_workflow_with_failure():
    """Test workflow where job fails."""
    c = Controller()
    
    g1 = c.start()
    assert c.busy == True
    
    # Poll - failed

    assert c.busy == False  # Failed ends busy
